description.p: OpenDictate is a desktop voice dictation and speech-to-text application. It combines private offline transcription with multi-provider Cloud AI models to turn spoken voice into clean, polished text.

ul.li: Offline on-device speech recognition powered by Whisper GGML models
Multi-provider Cloud AI transcription and text refinement
Hardware-aware microphone routing across System Default, Headphones, and Handsfree devices
Floating MiniBar overlay for hands-free dictation across active windows
Persistent local dictation history with quick clipboard copy and deletion
Interface localization across 28 languages with adaptive dark and light themes
Desktop text insertion, system tray indicator, and global keyboard shortcuts

screenshot.caption: Main settings window with Cloud AI and offline Whisper configuration
Header menu with 28-language localization and dictation history
Floating MiniBar overlay with live acoustic waveform and transcript drawer
Adaptive light theme with offline Whisper speech model management

description.p: Major release featuring offline Whisper GGML speech recognition, multi-provider Cloud AI transcription, 28-language localization, and persistent dictation history.

ul.li: Adaptive dark and light user interface themes
Dual-engine speech recognition supporting offline Whisper models and Cloud AI providers
Real-time interface localization across 28 languages with Right-to-Left layout support
In-popover dictation history viewer with clipboard copy and record management
Floating MiniBar recording pill with live acoustic waveform visualization
